inventory_source: frozen Attempt07 canonical final-route STA/ODB-equivalent DEF/SPEF at seed 11

measurement_notes.transition: Exact OpenSTA report_slews min/max-analysis rise/fall values; transition_value_ns is their maximum.
measurement_notes.capacitance: Extracted SPEF *D_NET parasitic capacitance in pF. The file declares PIN_CAP NONE, so this field does not invent a Liberty pin-cap contribution.
measurement_notes.wire_length: Manhattan sum of routed DEF segments, excluding via vertical distance; unit um.
measurement_notes.layers: Per-net routed DEF segment length by layer.
